exercises.title: Vocabulary: homes (Ex. 1)
exercises.instruction: A common topic in the exam is "home". Put these words under the correct heading.

items.explanation: beach — bãi biển → vị trí.
city centre — trung tâm thành phố → vị trí.
mountains — vùng núi → vị trí.
countryside — vùng nông thôn → vị trí.
remote island — hòn đảo xa xôi → vị trí.
apartment — căn hộ → kiểu nhà.
skyscraper — nhà chọc trời → kiểu nhà.
bungalow — nhà một tầng → kiểu nhà.
mansion — dinh thự → kiểu nhà.
castle — lâu đài → kiểu nhà.
garage — nhà để xe (công trình riêng) → kiểu nhà.
glamorous — lộng lẫy, hào nhoáng → phong cách.
simple — đơn giản → phong cách.
traditional — truyền thống → phong cách.
modern — hiện đại → phong cách.
spacious — rộng rãi → phong cách.
cellar — hầm (chứa rượu, đồ) → phòng.
gym — phòng tập → phòng.
dining room — phòng ăn → phòng.
staircase — cầu thang → bộ phận trong nhà.
floor — sàn nhà → bộ phận.
ceiling — trần nhà → bộ phận.
window — cửa sổ → bộ phận.
wood — gỗ → vật liệu.
marble — đá cẩm thạch → vật liệu.
leather — da thuộc → vật liệu.
stone — đá → vật liệu.

exercises.title: Skimming or scanning? (Ex. 3)
exercises.instruction: For each activity, decide whether you would use skimming or scanning.

items.text: looking up a word in the dictionary
items.explanation: Tìm đúng một từ → scan.

items.text: browsing the internet for the latest news stories
items.explanation: Lướt xem có tin gì → skim.

items.text: choosing a book from a library or bookshop
items.explanation: Đọc lướt để biết sách nói về gì → skim.

items.text: finding a particular news story in a newspaper
items.explanation: Tìm một bài cụ thể → scan.

items.text: finding the price of a product in a catalogue
items.explanation: Tìm một con số → scan.

items.text: looking through a magazine for an interesting article
items.explanation: Lướt tìm bài hay → skim.

exercises.title: What did you focus on when skimming? (Ex. 6)
exercises.instruction: When you were skim reading the text, which of these types of word did you focus on?

items.explanation: Tên riêng cho biết bài nói về ai, ở đâu.
Động từ mang hành động chính → cần chú ý khi đọc lướt.
Tính từ cho biết đặc điểm/ý kiến → cần chú ý.
Con số (năm, giá, số đo) là thông tin nổi bật → cần chú ý.
Giới từ (in, on, at…) không mang ý chính.
Mạo từ (a, an, the) không mang ý chính.

exercises.title: An overall title (Ex. 6)
exercises.instruction: Skim the text. What overall title would you give the text?

stimulus.text:
**A** Mukesh Ambani is one of the richest men in the world, and the first man to own a private residence costing more than one billion dollars to build. The home is on Altamount Road in Mumbai, one of the most expensive addresses in the world. Named after the mythical island Antilia, the property has 27 floors.

**B** The interior of the home is very glamorous and each floor is made from different materials to give an individual look. Marble floors, rare wood and fine rugs are just some of the design features used to create this extravagant home. The lotus flower and the sun are common symbols used throughout. Many of the rooms have floor-to-ceiling glass windows, offering spectacular views of Mumbai and the Arabian Sea.

**C** The skyscraper has a multi-storey garage with space for 168 cars. Alternatively, there are also three helipads on the roof of the building. The lobby has numerous reception areas and nine lifts. There are also several floors for dining, vast libraries and a health spa, including a gym, several swimming pools and yoga facilities. There is even an 'ice-room' which creates man-made snow, a Hindu prayer room and several floors of gardens.

**D** The Ambani residence is clearly designed to entertain guests. It has a theatre which seats 50, several guest bedrooms and a grand ballroom filled with chandeliers.

**E** The living quarters are on the top floors, because the family wanted as much sunlight as possible. The 400,000 ft² residence requires 600 staff, but all three Am bani children are required to clean their own rooms when they are at home.

**F** Several experts have criticised the architecture of this very expensive home, comparing it to an 'unstable pile of books'. Mrs Ambani, however, describes her home as 'an elevated house on top of a garden' and 'a modern home with an Indian heart'.
stimulus.caption: The home in the photo (p. 9)

options.text: Antilia: a billion-dollar home in Mumbai
The richest men in the world

items.explanation: Cả bài nói về ngôi nhà Antilia ở Mumbai (chủ nhà, vật liệu, tiện nghi, ý kiến). B chỉ là chi tiết ở đoạn A; C không có trong bài.

exercises.title: Synonyms for paraphrasing (Ex. 9)
exercises.instruction: The key to paraphrasing is understanding synonyms and words or phrases with a similar meaning. Match these words and expressions.

items.explanation: desirable facilities (tiện ích hấp dẫn) → ví dụ cụ thể: health spa và libraries.
outside spaces (không gian ngoài trời) ≈ gardens.
inside ≈ interior (nội thất, bên trong).
extravagant (xa hoa) ≈ expensive.
city → tên thành phố cụ thể: Mumbai.
visitors ≈ guests (khách).

items.left: equipped to make visitors feel welcome
items.explanation: equipped to make visitors feel welcome ≈ designed to entertain guests.
expensive materials → ví dụ cụ thể: gỗ quý hiếm và thảm cao cấp.

exercises.title: The mindmap (Ex. 12)
exercises.instruction: Put these words and phrases with the appropriate tense in the mindmap.

items.explanation: Hành động tạm thời → hiện tại tiếp diễn.

items.text: an action which is not complete
items.explanation: Hành động chưa hoàn tất → hiện tại tiếp diễn.

items.text: happening at the time of speaking
items.explanation: Đang xảy ra lúc nói → hiện tại tiếp diễn.
Hành động lặp lại → hiện tại đơn.
Sự thật chung → hiện tại đơn.
Ý kiến (think, believe…) → hiện tại đơn.

exercises.title: Correct the sentences (Ex. 13)
exercises.instruction: Using the rules in the mindmap, correct these sentences where necessary. If a sentence is already correct, write it again.

items.prompt: Mukesh Ambani is living in Mumbai.
items.explanation: Sự thật chung (nơi ông ấy sống lâu dài) → present simple.

items.prompt: Mrs Ambani is believing that her home has an Indian heart.
items.answer: Mrs Ambani believes that her home has an Indian heart.
items.explanation: believe là động từ chỉ ý kiến → không chia tiếp diễn.

items.prompt: The family live on the top floor because they want as much exposure to sunlight as possible.
items.answer: The family live on the top floor because they want as much exposure to sunlight as possible.
items.explanation: Câu đúng: sự thật chung + mong muốn (want không chia tiếp diễn).

items.prompt: When the children are at home, they are cleaning their own rooms.
items.answer: When the children are at home, they clean their own rooms.
items.explanation: Việc lặp lại mỗi khi ở nhà → present simple.

items.prompt: Mrs Ambani entertains her guests in the ballroom at the moment.
items.answer: Mrs Ambani is entertaining her guests in the ballroom at the moment.
items.explanation: "at the moment" → đang xảy ra lúc nói → present continuous.

exercises.title: Present simple or present continuous? (Ex. 14)
exercises.instruction: Complete the sentences using the word in brackets and the correct form of the present continuous or the present simple.

items.prompt: Currently, my mum ____ (work) in the study.
items.explanation: "Currently" → đang diễn ra.

items.prompt: I ____ (rent) in the city centre for now.
items.explanation: "for now" → tạm thời.

items.prompt: I ____ (think) that buying a new house now would be a very good idea.
items.explanation: think = cho rằng (ý kiến) → present simple.

items.prompt: What is that going to be? They ____ (build) a new accommodation block for students.
items.explanation: Việc xây đang diễn ra, chưa xong.

items.prompt: Every day his mum ____ (clean) the house.
items.explanation: "Every day" → thói quen.

exercises.title: Predict the kind of information (Ex. 3)
exercises.instruction: Look at the notes and think about the kind of information that you will need for each gap.

items.explanation: Cần tên đường (có thể được đánh vần).
Number of… → một con số.
Number of… → một con số.

items.text: Access to the ____ through sun-room door
items.explanation: Một nơi: the garden.
Đồ dùng nhà bếp.
Appointment time → giờ hẹn.
Họ của người — chú ý đánh vần.
Số điện thoại — nghe theo từng cụm số.

exercises.title: Why are the other options wrong? (Ex. 7)
exercises.instruction: Look at this example. "The en-suite bathroom will be useful because A it has a shower unit. B it has a big bath. C it helps everyone in the mornings." The answer is C.

options.text: It is true, but it is not the reason why the bathroom will be useful for the woman and her family.
It is not true: the en-suite bathroom has no shower.
The woman does not like showers.

items.explanation: "it only has a shower unit" — đúng sự thật, nhưng không phải lý do nó hữu ích.

options.text: It is not true: the big bath is in the main bathroom, not the en-suite.
The woman says the bath is too small.
It is true, but the woman does not mention it.

items.explanation: "not a big bath like the main bathroom".

options.text: The woman says it will be useful "when we all get up to get ready for school or work" — that happens in the morning.
The estate agent says it is the best room in the house.
The woman says she has three children.

items.explanation: Cùng nghĩa với bài nghe dù không dùng chữ "morning".
